 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Missouri State (4-6, 3-3 in CUSA) goes on the road for its penultimate regular season game on Saturday, Nov. 21. The Bears will visit Jacksonville State (7-3, 5-1), a team Missouri State is an undefeated 5-0 all-time against.
 Missouri State's bowl eligibility hopes continues. The Bears need a win over the Gamecocks to keep their postseason dreams alive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bears and Gamecocks will play each other at 1 p.m. CT. The game will not be broadcast on TV, but it can be watched on streaming platform ESPN+.
